I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the deadline is **19 November**.

- **Why not 21 December:** Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team on 14 Oct. Later that day he corrected it to 19 November in #north-random, saying he'd "read the wrong line." Dana is in #north-random, so she could already see the correction.
- **Still wrong in #north-team:** his original post and my saved note there still say 21 December. The correction was never posted in #north-team. It's worth asking Marcus to fix it there so nobody else picks up the old date.
- **Not checked against a file:** I couldn't find any Thornbury account files, so 19 November is the latest word from Marcus.
